entry_points.summary: Thin bash wrapper; single entrypoint for all consultant/reviewer dispatch sites
Loads configs, merges, validates, checks PATH, enforces invariant, prints JSON descriptor or sentinel 'none'
frozenset of roles that return sentinel 'none' when Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off: consultant_primary, consultant_secondary, reviewer
Locates and loads global + repo JSON; validates schema version; runs v1->v2 upgrade
In-memory v1->v2 upgrade: adds model_arg_template/model_env_var/default_model nulls; emits provider_schema_v1_upgraded (memoized per process+path)
Per-key merge of global + repo configs across providers/roles/aliases with shadow detection
Role->provider->command lookup with alias substitution and PATH presence check; exits 1 if unresolvable
Checks provider name against aliases map; substitutes canonical and emits provider_alias_used (memoized); emits legacy_provider_roles_used when is_legacy=True
Emits provider_alias_used event via log-event.sh (best-effort, non-fatal; memoization in _apply_aliases)
Emits legacy_provider_roles_used event when providers.json.roles is the active role-binding path
Invariant: consultant_primary != consultant_secondary; exits 1 on collision; SKIPPED when Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off
Builds full argv from descriptor + effective_model; renders {model} in model_arg_template; raises ValueError if no model
Validates all required fields for a single provider entry; exits 2 on any field violation
Probes PATH for known CLIs (codex/gemini/claude/ollama/agy/gpt); returns proposed providers.json dict (never writes)
Detects 'none' sentinel before JSON parse; emits provider_resolution_skipped event; appends role=skipped(consult=off) to summary
Python API wrapper around resolve-provider.py for runtime dispatch layer
JSON Schema Draft 7 for .z-harness/providers.json; accepts version 1+2; permits kind=cli|sdk; allow_cross_vendor_env field

invariants: consultant_primary and consultant_secondary must resolve to distinct provider names (raw roles map values) — resolver exits 1 if they collide. This check is SKIPPED entirely when Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off.
When Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off, resolve-provider.py prints the plaintext sentinel 'none' (exit 0) for roles consultant_primary, consultant_secondary, and reviewer — before any config file is loaded.
The sentinel 'none' is a plaintext string, not JSON. Any consumer that receives 'none' must skip JSON parsing and must not dispatch to an external model CLI.
Repo-local config overrides user-global config per-key across providers, roles, and aliases sections. Shadowing emits provider_shadowed event and stderr warning, de-duped per parent process.
Schema version field must be 1 or 2; any other value causes exit 2. Version 1 is upgraded in-memory to v2 automatically.
Every provider entry in the merged config is validated on every resolver call, not just the entry being resolved.
discover-providers.py never writes files — all writes go through /z-providers-discover with explicit user confirmation.
compose_argv raises ValueError (not sys.exit) when no model can be resolved from effective_model or provider default_model.
providers.json.roles is the legacy fallback for role binding; TOML [roles.<command>.<role>] takes precedence when both exist. Using providers.json.roles emits legacy_provider_roles_used.

.z-harness/providers.json v2 ships both old names (codex/gemini/claude/cursor/agy) and new -cli names (codex-cli/gemini-cli/claude-cli/cursor-cli/agy-cli) as first-class provider entries; aliases map provides forward-compat without deleting old entries.
gotchas: Z_HARNESS_CONSULT=off bypasses config loading and the distinctness check entirely — setting it is sufficient; no providers.json change needed.

log-providers.sh checks for 'none' at line 34 BEFORE calling any python JSON parse. Previously, receiving 'none' caused json.load to crash. The guard ensures a clean provider_resolution_skipped event is emitted instead.

Consumer contract for 'none': /z-plan skips Phase 3 and Phase 7 external consults; /z-implement-all routes its reviewer gate to a self-reviewer subagent (agents/self-reviewer.md) that never calls resolve-provider or any external CLI.

Schema at runtime/contract/provider.schema.json permits kind='sdk' and optional auth_env/session_resumable/allow_cross_vendor_env, but resolve-provider.py validates only kind='cli' — SDK entries pass schema but cause exit 2 if resolved.
Z_HARNESS_REPO_PROVIDERS env var overrides repo config path entirely, bypassing git-based discovery.
Shadow de-dup stamp file is keyed on PPID, not PID — warning fires once per parent process tree, not once per subshell.
Role with no bound provider causes immediate halt with actionable error pointing to /z-providers-discover.
CLI not on PATH causes exit 1 even if the config entry is otherwise valid.
_upgrade_v1_to_v2 is memoized per (process, file path) via module-level _v1_upgrade_emitted set — double-emission is prevented when both global and repo configs are v1.

aliases section IS used by resolve() via _apply_aliases — it is not merely informational. Current aliases map (5 entries): codex->codex-cli, gemini->gemini-cli, claude->claude-cli, cursor->cursor-cli, agy->agy-cli. Old alias names are transparently resolved to canonical -cli names; provider_alias_used emitted once per (process, old-name).
When the roles map in providers.json is the active binding path, both legacy_provider_roles_used AND (if an alias is matched) provider_alias_used are emitted — two distinct events for one resolution.
_alias_used_emitted memoization set is module-level; alias dedup survives multiple resolve() calls within the same process but resets on new process invocations.

cursor/cursor-cli provider (command: cursor-agent) is NOT probed by discover-providers.py — must be added manually. It uses model_arg_template and default_model='auto', unlike the legacy null-template providers.
